description: Turns one piece of finished content (blog post, newsletter, podcast, video) into platform-native social assets for the 2-3 platforms the brand actually operates, with depth on a few platforms instead of rephrased spray across eight. Use when source content exists and needs distribution, when a post's comments need ranked reply drafts, or when a week of posts should be planned from one source.
